subject: Overage: request for token provenance & VAT reverse-charge — Horizon Analytics
messages:
From: Sofia Marquez <sofia.marquez@horizon-analytics.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing@horizon-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2026 08:12:00 +0200
Subject: Unexpected March overage + VAT reverse-charge question

Hi Ben,

We noticed a substantial usage spike on our March invoice (Invoice #HZN-2026-03) — roughly 1.2M extra tokens compared to February. Our finance team shows a VAT line being charged on that invoice, but Horizon should be reverse-charged for EU B2B purchases (we submitted VAT ID GB123456789 earlier in January).

Can you:
- Share per-request provenance (request IDs, timestamps, model, token counts) for March 15–18 (UTC) where the bulk of the spike occurred;
- Confirm whether a reverse-charge was applied and, if not, why VAT was billed;
- Put a provisional hold/credit on the VAT portion while we confirm on our side — we can provide a copy of the VAT registration and PO if helpful.

Attached is a short CSV snippet we exported from our side (usage_request_snippet.txt) with timestamps and request IDs. We also pulled the signed PO for the quarterly commitment (attached).

We need this resolved before our accounts payable processes payment next week.

Thanks,
Sofia Marquez
Head of Finance, Horizon Analytics
sofia.marquez@horizon-analytics.com

Attachments: usage_request_snippet.txt (text), signed_PO_HZN_4509.pdf (PDF)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Marquez <sofia.marquez@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2026 09:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Unexpected March overage + VAT reverse-charge question

Hi Sofia — thanks for the heads up and for the snippet + PO. Sorry for the disruption.

Quick plan:
1) I'll loop in Billing and Product Ops to pull the per-request export for 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-18 and map the request IDs to our token ledger.
2) Grace (cc) will confirm whether Horizon's VAT ID is on file and whether reverse-charge should have been applied.
3) We'll provisionally flag the VAT line on your account and propose a provisional credit while we investigate — please confirm the PO number (HZN-4509) is correct.

Sofia, could you confirm whether those request IDs in your snippet are internal dev/test traffic (e.g., staging keys) or production? That helps speed root cause. If you prefer a brief call, I can set one up today.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0132

Subject: ACTION: Export token-provenance + VAT validation for Horizon (HZN-2026-Q2)

Team — please action the following for Horizon Analytics (account HZN-2026):

1) Export per-request logs for 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z through 2026-03-18T23:59:59Z. Required fields: request_id, timestamp (UTC), model_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, route (hosted/dedicated/private), api_key_id. Prefer CSV with request_id as first column.
2) Produce a mapping from api_key_id -> customer namespace to validate whether any staging/sandbox keys contributed to the spike.
3) Confirm whether the customer's VAT ID (GB123456789) is present in our billing profile and whether we applied reverse-charge for the March invoice. If reverse-charge was NOT applied, include an explanation and approximate remediation (credit or corrected invoice).
4) Propose a provisional credit amount for the VAT line pending final reconciliation; finance needs a suggested journal entry description (e.g., "Provisional VAT hold - Horizon"), and a target timeline (24–72h).

Sofia — cc'd above. We'll share the export and proposed credit estimate as soon as possible. If the CSV from your side contains internal test keys, indicate those rows so we can exclude them.

Attachments: investigation_template.csv (internal stub)

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

We appreciate a provisional credit for the VAT portion while you confirm the token provenance and reclassify the charges if appropriate. Please send the export link and a proposed credit amount when available.

Sofia
